question.en: Which area does the BenchCouncil annual table assign to Least-to-most prompting?
question.zh: BenchCouncil 年度表把 Least-to-most prompting 归入哪个领域？

explanation.en: Least-to-most prompting appears in the LLM area of the official annual table.
explanation.zh: Least-to-most prompting 位于官方年度表的“大语言模型”领域。
